note: Re-judged after the no-notify branch changed from a refusal to a legacy signature. RFC 7427 Section 3 grants method 14 only once the notify was sent and received by each peer. Received half: TestRFC7427DigitalSignatureNeedsTheNotify drives computeX509Auth with RemoteHashAlgos nil and fails on method 14 (and pins the P-256 key's method 9), then sets a received list and requires method 14, so a computeX509Auth that ignored the notify goes red on one branch or the other. Sent half: TestRFC7427IKESAInitSendsTheSignatureHashAlgorithmsNotify parses Ze's real IKE_SA_INIT request and responder reply, each carrying exactly one notify listing 2,3,4. TestAuthX509UsesMethod14 positive, PSK uses method 2. The recorded discrimination breaks are whole-body panics, which prove only that each unit reaches its producer; the branch discrimination above is read from the assertions. Untagged support: TestParseHashAlgoNotifyShort keeps nil meaning no notify received.
